# Privacy Policy

Effective: 29 October 2026

This policy explains what **Clavexis** collects on ai.clavexis.com and through the ClavexisAI licence
server, in line with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Contact: contact@clavexis.com.

## What we collect and why

| Data | Why |
|---|---|
| Name, email, password (stored only as a salted hash) | Your account, sending licence keys and receipts |
| Orders: plan, amount, payment method, the transaction reference you give us, payer name | Matching payments, invoices, refunds, tax records |
| Licence agreement signature: typed name, date, agreement version, IP address, browser | Proof that the licence agreement was accepted |
| Licence activations: key, anonymous device ID, device name, app version, IP address, dates | Enforcing device limits and preventing key sharing |
| Licence and update checks from the app: licence key, install ID, app version | Keeping the licence valid and telling you when an update is out |
| Download logs | Counting downloads |
| Early access and "notify me" emails | One confirmation email when you join, then telling you when ClavexisAI or the phone apps launch. Reply "remove" to any of these emails to be taken off the list. Until our own server is running, sign-ups reach us through Formsubmit (formsubmit.co), which also sends the confirmation email |

We never see or store card details. Payments are made to us directly or through the payment provider shown at checkout, which tells us only that an order was paid.

## What we don't collect

The ClavexisAI app runs on your computer. Your chats, photos, files, email, calendars, memory and settings
stay there; we never receive them. If you choose a cloud AI provider in the app (with your own key), your
messages go from your computer straight to that provider under its own privacy policy, not through us.
The app's in-app Privacy page lists exactly what it keeps on your computer and what it sends where.

## Sharing

We don't sell or rent personal data. We share it only with service providers that help us run the
site (such as hosting and email), with our bank or payment providers for payments, and where the
law requires it.

## Keeping it

Account data is kept while your account exists. Order, invoice and licence-agreement records are
kept for 8 years for tax and legal reasons. Activation logs are kept while the licence is active and
for one year after.

## Your rights

You can ask to see, correct or delete your data, or withdraw consent, by emailing
contact@clavexis.com. Questions or complaints about how we handle your data: our Grievance Officer at contact@clavexis.com. Some records (orders, invoices, signed agreements) must be kept by law even
after an account is deleted.

## Cookies

We use one essential cookie, `cx_session`, to keep you signed in. No advertising or tracking cookies.
